product_title: Resin Purple Shubh Labh Decorative Door Hanging Set with Pearl Tassels (3 inches)
product_description: Welcome prosperity and positivity into your home with this elegant Shubh Labh hanging set. Featuring rich purple panels, golden lettering, pearl embellishments, and delicate pearl tassels, it adds a festive touch to main doors, entrances, and pooja rooms. Perfect for Diwali décor and auspicious gifting.
product_care_suggestion: Dust gently with a soft, dry cloth.
Keep away from water, moisture, and harsh chemicals.
Handle pearl embellishments and tassels carefully.
Store in the original box in a cool, dry place.
